notes: Read the full 48-line numbered source before editing. L1 imports forwardRef + HTMLAttributes (React) -> forwardRef + ReactNode (React) with the DOM-only HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> replaced by Omit<ViewProps,'style'> (rule 4: no DOM types in native). L2 imports cn from @/lib/cn -> dropped: cn only merged Tailwind class strings and React Native has no className, so styling moves to StyleSheet + colour literals; className is retained on props (BadgeProps) for source compatibility and destructured as _className (ignored), matching the RadialGauge/HelixMark sibling ports.

The variants map (L4-10: info/success/warning/danger/neutral) is ported with identical keys. Each web entry has a light + `dark:` pair; the native app renders dark, so the canonical tints use the `dark:` hex literals: info dark:bg-blue-900 #1e3a8a / dark:text-blue-200 #bfdbfe; success dark:bg-green-900 #14532d / dark:text-green-200 #bbf7d0; warning dark:bg-yellow-900 #713f12 / dark:text-yellow-200 #fef08a; danger dark:bg-red-900 #7f1d1d / dark:text-red-200 #fecaca; neutral dark:bg-gray-700 #374151 / dark:text-gray-200 #e5e7eb. `as const` (L10) becomes a Record<BadgeVariant,VariantStyle> typed const.

The badgeSizes map (L12-19) is ported with identical keys (sm/md/lg/auto). Tailwind spacing -> px (1 unit = 4px): sm px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs -> {6,2,fontSize 12,lineHeight 16}; md px-2 py-0.5 text-xs -> {8,2,12,16}; lg px-2.5 py-1 text-sm -> {10,4,14,20}. The L16-17 density comment and `auto` px-d-pad-x py-d-pad-y text-xs (L18) are preserved: native has no CSS-variable density cascade (the web --density-pad-* vars flow from the ui_density setting), so auto resolves statically to the default 'comfortable' density values --density-pad-x 1rem=16 / --density-pad-y 0.75rem=12, documented in the file header + this sidecar.

BadgeProps (L21-25) is ported: variant?:keyof variants -> BadgeVariant, size?:keyof badgeSizes -> BadgeSize, dot?:boolean kept verbatim; the HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> base (L21) becomes Omit<ViewProps,'style'> plus native-only style?:StyleProp<ViewStyle>, 'data-testid'?, and an explicit children?:ReactNode. The forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement,BadgeProps> component (L27-47) becomes forwardRef<View,BadgeProps>: the L28 default props (variant='neutral', size='md', dot, className, children, ...props) are preserved as the same defaults, className renamed _className, props -> ...rest spread onto the View (L41 {...props}). variants[variant] (L37) + badgeSizes[size] (L38) lookups are kept (as tint/sizing, with ??neutral/??md null guards).

The web <span> chip (L29-45) becomes a <View>: the base class list (L32 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full font-medium) -> styles.base flexDirection row + alignSelf flex-start (inline-flex) + alignItems center + gap 4 + borderRadius 9999, with font-medium ('500') applied to the label AppText. variants[variant] bg (L37) -> backgroundColor, badgeSizes padding (L38) -> paddingHorizontal/paddingVertical inline. The forced-colors border (L33-36 forced-colors:border forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]) is an OS high-contrast CSS affordance with no React Native analog -> unavailable on native and intentionally omitted (the badge has no border outside forced-colors mode), per rule 7.

The dot (L43 {dot && <span class='h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-current'/>}) -> conditional 6x6 View (h-1.5/w-1.5=6) with borderRadius 9999 (rounded-full) tinted backgroundColor=tint.text (bg-current === inherited text colour), flagged accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility no-hide-descendants (decorative). The label {children} (L44) inherits the span text colour on web, so on native it is wrapped in AppText carrying tint.text + size fontSize/lineHeight + font-medium (string->AppText approach from StatusPill/SourceLayerBadge); guarded with children!=null. Badge.displayName='Badge' (L48) is preserved; a default export is added for native ergonomics.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only React + type-only react-native StyleProp/TextStyle/ViewProps/ViewStyle plus StyleSheet/View, and the existing apps/native AppText primitive (rule 5). Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint @react-native), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) all pass.
